title: 「in that」說明具體方面／特定理由
titleZh: 「in that」說明具體方面／特定理由
titleEn: Using in that to explain a specific respect or reason

source.file: Sentence Structure 130 -「in that」說明具體方面／特定理由.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Main statement + in that + subject + verb + other information

formulas.formula: Main statement + in that + subject + verb + other information
Subject + be + adjective + in that + complete clause
A differs from B + in that + complete clause
Subject + has changed / improved + in that + complete clause

example: My parents are different in that they always encourage independent thinking.
exampleZh: 我的父母與眾不同之處，在於他們總是鼓勵獨立思考。

examples.en: My parents are different in that they always encourage independent thinking.
examples.zh: 我的父母與眾不同之處，在於他們總是鼓勵獨立思考。
examples.highlight: in that they always encourage independent thinking

rules.zh: in that 後面必須接完整子句 完整子句需要包括主語和動詞。
rules.en: In that must be followed by a complete clause containing a subject and a verb.
examples: The course is practical in that students complete real workplace tasks.

rules.zh: in that 通常接在描述、評價或比較之後 常見搭配包括：
rules.en: In that commonly follows a description, evaluation or comparison, including combinations such as different, similar, unique, useful, effective, limited, fair, unusual, better or differ + in that.

rules.zh: in that 前面通常不加逗號 本練習統一使用不加逗號的形式。
rules.en: Normally do not put a comma before in that; this lesson consistently uses the form without a comma.
examples: The system is secure in that it requires two passwords.
The two plans differ in that one costs less.

rules.zh: in that 與 Because / Since / As 的分別 Because、since 和 as 通常說明一個行動、事件或結果發生的普通原因。 這裏的 because 回答： in that 則通常說明一項描述、評價或比較在哪一個具體方面成立。 這裏的 in that 回答： 因此，兩者並非在所有句子中都可以互換。 此外，since 亦可以表示「自從」，而 as 亦可以表示「當……時」或「以……方式」。 in that 沒有這些時間或方式的意思。
rules.en: In that identifies a specific respect, unlike the broader causal linkers because, since and as. Those linkers normally explain the ordinary cause of an action, event or result and answer ‘Why did this happen?’. In that explains the particular respect in which a description, evaluation or comparison is true and answers ‘In what particular way is this true?’, so the forms are not interchangeable in every sentence. Since can also mean ‘from a past time’, and as can also mean ‘when’ or ‘in a particular manner’; in that has none of those time or manner meanings.
examples: I stayed at home because it was raining.
Why did I stay at home?
The plan is risky in that it depends on only one supplier.
In what particular way is the plan risky?

benefits.zh: 清楚指出「具體是哪一方面」 這個句型不只說某事是好、壞、特別或不同，還會立即解釋這個評價所指的具體方面。
benefits.en: It clearly identifies the specific respect meant. The structure does more than call something good, bad, special or different: it immediately explains the precise aspect to which the evaluation applies.
examples: The service is helpful in that it provides support throughout the night.

benefits.zh: 令解釋更加準確 使用 because 有時只會提供一個普通原因；使用 in that 則能把讀者的注意力帶到某個特定特 點。 第二句特別強調：「成本較低」是這個計劃較優勝的其中一個具體方面。
benefits.en: It makes an explanation more precise. Because may provide only a general reason, whereas in that directs attention to a particular feature; in the comparison, the second sentence specifically presents lower cost as one respect in which the plan is better.

benefits.zh: 把主要觀點和支持資料連接起來 你可以先提出一項判斷，再立即加入證據或詳細解釋。
benefits.en: It connects a main point with supporting information, allowing you to state a judgement and immediately add evidence or a detailed explanation.
examples: The report is convincing in that every claim is supported by evidence.

benefits.zh: 避免重複使用 because 學生在作文和說話時經常重複使用 because。 in that 提供另一種表達方式，令句式更多元。
benefits.en: It avoids repeatedly using because and gives essays and spoken answers greater structural variety.

benefits.zh: 適合比較、分析和正式解釋 這個句型常用於作文、報告、簡報和較有分析性的討論，尤其適合： ● 解釋一項政策的特點； ● 比較兩個方案； ● 評價一個方法； ● 指出某個制度的限制； ● 說明一項改變具體發生在哪裏。
benefits.en: It is useful for comparisons, analysis and formal explanations in essays, reports, presentations and analytical discussions, especially for explaining a policy’s features, comparing two options, evaluating a method, identifying a system’s limitations or specifying where a change has occurred.
